boards.hardware: Any ESP32-S3 board with 16 MB flash, plus an ES8311 codec module and a push button wired as in config.h
boards.identify: Hand-wired; there is no product to match
boards.flash_port: The board's USB port. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Minimal live speech-to-text example: hold the button and the mic audio streams to the App over BLE
boards.notes: The talk button is active-high on GPIO8. Check the user's wiring against boards/es8311-asr/config.h before flashing.

zh.product: 接线示例：ESP32-S3 + ES8311（只用麦克风）
zh.hardware: 任意 16 MB Flash 的 ESP32-S3 开发板，按 config.h 接一个 ES8311 音频模块和一个按键
zh.identify: 自己接线，没有对应的成品
zh.flash_port: 开发板的 USB 口。下载模式：按住 BOOT 再插 USB。
zh.use: 最小实时语音转文字示例：按住按键，麦克风音频通过 BLE 发给 App
zh.notes: 说话键在 GPIO8，高电平有效。烧录前按 boards/es8311-asr/config.h 核对用户的接线。
